question: Who won the 2025 Asian Snooker Championship men's title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pankaj Advani**, India’s ace cueist, secured the men's title at the 2025 Asian Snooker Championship.
 
• He is renowned for his exceptional skill in both snooker and billiards, having won multiple international titles.
 
• This victory added to his illustrious career, making him one of the most decorated players in the history of cue sports.
 
• Pankaj Advani has consistently represented India on the global stage and remains a dominant force in cue sports.
 
• The championship featured top players from across Asia, highlighting Advani’s ability to outperform strong competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Snooker Championship:** A prestigious annual tournament organized by the Asian Confederation of Billiard Sports (ACBS).
 
• **Snooker:** A cue sport played on a rectangular table covered with green cloth, involving 21 balls and a cue stick.
 
• **Pankaj Advani's Achievements:** He holds numerous world titles, including gold medals in the World Billiards Championship and IBSF World Snooker Championship.
 
• **ACBS:** The governing body for cue sports in Asia, responsible for organizing championships and promoting snooker and billiards.
 
• Advani’s dominance in both snooker and billiards showcases the versatility and depth of his talent in cue sports.
